Gauntlet: Dragon Risen
Gauntlet: Dragon Risen map guide

One map, eleven regions, a single road east.

One road runs east, and everything on it wants you dead. You begin in a harbour town — Thundoria in the north, Shaitan in the south — and fight through eleven regions: ruined cities, drowned swamps, frozen halls, and black stone deeper than daylight, each one harder than the last. The road ends at the Black Dragon's lair, and the last stretch can only be reached by teleporter.

The run · levels 1 → 85

How you cross the Gauntlet

Every step east is gated by level. Each Gatekeeper turns away anyone under its destination’s minimum, so the road is walked in one direction and the whole population moves as a wave.

start here

Thundoria & Shaitan Harbour

Two harbour towns, one road. Thundoria sits green and snowbound in the north-west, Shaitan sandy behind its U-shaped breakwater in the south. They are separate landmasses that share a porter, so both populations feed east into the same road.

2 mini bosses · monsters Lv 1–35
Lv 35+

Silver Mine

The first squeeze. Cream corridors cut through brown rock and ringed in black stone, far tighter than anything before it. Most players leave the mine a different class than they entered it.

1 boss · 4 mini bosses · 11 chests · monsters Lv 23–42
Lv 45+

Forsaken City

The largest region on the map: a sprawl of ruined sand-coloured city, and the first place the road stops being a lane and becomes contested ground.

1 boss · 3 mini bosses · 11 chests · monsters Lv 40–54
Lv 55+

Dark Swamp

The map exhales. The most open ground in the Gauntlet and the only stretch where a fight can genuinely be fled -- but it narrows to a waist only a few paces across, which makes it the natural place to hold a line.

1 boss · 4 mini bosses · 10 chests · monsters Lv 42–64
Lv 65+

Demonic World

Blue-white ice brickwork, and the first Rebirth Altar. The population that continues east from here is materially stronger than the one that arrived.

2 bosses · 2 mini bosses · 8 chests · monsters Lv 63–77
Lv 75+

Lone Tower

A tight room maze of near-uniform brick under a blue-purple tint, with little open floor anywhere in it.

1 boss · 2 mini bosses · 6 chests · monsters Lv 67–75
Lv 85+

Abaddon

Four quadrants of black stone joined by one wide hallway carved straight through the middle. The hallway is the only fast way across, and the second Rebirth Altar is here.

4 bosses · 13 chests · monsters Lv 75–85
Lv 85+

Black Dragon Lair

The densest ground on the map -- near-black stone packed with more scenery than anywhere else, and tight with it. The hallway from Abaddon feeds directly into the lair's western wall.

10 chests · monsters Lv 85–89
Lv 85+ · teleporter only

Black Dragon Lair 2

The arena, and the end of the road. No walkable ground joins it to anywhere: the porter is the only way in, and the Black Dragon is the only thing here.

1 boss · monsters Lv 90

There are no safe zones on this map

Nowhere on this map disables fighting. PvP is gated purely by level: damage is nullified below Lv 45, or between guildmates — never by standing somewhere.
